caption: The drawing consists of a centrally placed square filled with a complex geometric pattern created from a grid of repeating rectangular and circular shapes. The composition is divided into smaller rectangles, each displaying a unique arrangement of red, blue, and beige forms. The majority of the pattern involves alternating horizontal and vertical lines, dots, and grid motifs, with some sections containing rows of red or blue dots within a beige grid, while others have solid blocks of color intersected by parallel lines. The colors used are mainly red and blue for the patterns, set against a beige background both inside the square and extending outwards to the edges of the otherwise empty paper. The drawing is precisely aligned, and the square sits slightly above and left of the center of the paper. There is a small blue handwritten inscription in the lower right corner outside the patterned square.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
